info.name: Oracle Multicloud Omhub Resource Anchor API

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud base compartment or sub-compartment in which to list resources.
A Multicloud base compartment is an OCI compartment that maps to a subscription in a cloud service provider (such as Azure or AWS).

params.name: linkedCompartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment linked to the resource.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description:
A filter to return only resources that match the given lifecycle state. The
state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given display name exactly.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description:
The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).
In general, the sort order is `DESC` when sorting by time and `ASC` otherwise.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. You can provide only one sort order. Default order for `timeCreated`
is descending. Default order for `displayName` is ascending.

params.name: isCompartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: Check the sub-compartments of a given `compartmentId`.

params.name: shouldFetchCompartmentName
params.description:
Whether to fetch and include the compartment name.
Setting this field to `true` might introduce additional latency.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud subscription in which to list resources.

items.docs:
Lists resource anchors in the specified Multicloud subscription.
Details listed for each resource anchor include name, state, and the related Multicloud compartment.
For more information, see
[Listing Resource Anchors](/iaas/Content/multicloud-hub/list-resource-anchors.htm).

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud subscription in which to list resources.

params.name: shouldFetchCompartmentName
params.description:
Whether to fetch and include the compartment name.
Setting this field to `true` might introduce additional latency.

items.docs:
Gets details for the specified resource anchor. The subscription OCID and service name are required.
For more information, see
[Getting a Resource Anchor's Details (OCI)](/iaas/Content/multicloud-hub/get-resource-anchor.htm).
